name: Jesuit Missions of the Chiquitos
description: In the remote lowlands of eastern Bolivia, six towns began as Jesuit mission settlements founded between 1696 and 1760 and are still lived in today. Their wooden-columned churches blend European design with Indigenous craftsmanship. Restoration since the 1970s saved many of them, and a biennial festival now fills the towns with the baroque music the missionaries once taught.
